in_english.name: Waheedah
in_english.meaning: Waheedah means solitude, unity, and singularity in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Waheedah is derived from the Arabic root 'wahd', meaning unity, solitude, or singularity. This name holds significant spiritual connotations in Islamic tradition, emphasizing the oneness of God as mentioned in the Quran, particularly in Surah Al-Ikhlas. It symbolizes the unique and indivisible nature of God.
